description: A cream-gold floor-length court dress with a fitted opaque bodice, low square neckline, elbow-length sleeves and rich gold geometric woven-looking borders along the neckline, cuffs, waist and hem. A broad burgundy central skirt panel and burgundy outer wrap provide contrast; the wrap drapes around the lower arms and hangs at the sides, with gold decorative borders. Round gold brooch-like fastenings decorate the upper bodice corners and belt, with an ornate central waist clasp. Gold drop earrings, a pendant necklace and wrist bracelets are visible. One gold-toned shoe appears beneath the hem. Exact textile fibres are uncertain.
